messages.author: 67146b7dea6211b3
messages.subject: F1  Intercross Maps
parts:
Hi,

I've been flipping through documentation and I can't seem to find any evidence that Rqtl supports F1 hybrids for making genetic maps. I just wanted to confirm that is true and that there wasn't another way to categorize my data as an F1 population.

Specifically, I have around 150 genotyped diploid individuals with thousands of markers. The cross itself is experimental, in that the parents are in no way inbred.

Thanks,

Corey

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] F1  Intercross Maps
parts:
R/qtl has support for a phase-known 4-way cross, which could apply to F1 hybrids of two outbreds if the grandparental genotypes were available. Without grandparents, you'd have to first infer phase and so R/qtl isn't easy to apply in such a case.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] F1 Intercross Maps
parts:
I would want to treat such an F1 population from outbred parents as
"4way" (phase-known 4-way cross), but cim() and the mqm functions are
only implemented for backcross and F2 intercross from inbred lines.

> data(fake.4way)
> out <- cim(fake.4way)
Error in cim(fake.4way) :
  cim() has not been implemented for 4-way crosses
> out <- mqmaugment(fake.4way)
Error in mqmaugment(fake.4way) :
  Currently only F2, BC, and selfed RIL crosses can be analyzed by MQM.


karl
